# Weekly Business Review Notes

## Conclusions

- GMV was driven primarily by the East region, with web continuing to be the highest-value channel.
- Conversion is healthy enough for a weekly report headline, but order growth depends on keeping traffic quality stable.

## Risks

- West region volume is still thin, so a single low-performing campaign could distort regional comparisons.
- App channel GMV trails web, and the team should confirm whether this is traffic mix or checkout friction.

## Action Items

- Sales ops will prepare an East-region playbook for next week's campaign planning.
- Product analytics will review app checkout drop-off and report the top two friction points.
